title: Embodied-Reasoner: Synergizing Visual Search, Reasoning, and Action for Embodied Interactive Tasks
authors_zh: Wenqi Zhang、Mengna Wang、Gangao Liu、Huixin Xu、Yiwei Jiang、Yongliang Shen、Guiyang Hou、Zhe Zheng、Hang Zhang、Xin Li、Jiajun Liu、Weiming Lu、Peng Li、Yueting Zhuang
paper_type_zh: 具身多模态过程数据构造与开放发布
best_for_zh: 研究具身推理、环境验证、轨迹回放和多模态数据审计的读者
one_line: Embodied-Reasoner releases 9,390 AI2-THOR Observation-Thought-Action episodes built from GPT-4o imitation traces, environment-filtered self-exploration, and failure-aware reflection tuning, with about 64K images and 8M thought tokens.
Embodied-Reasoner 发布 9,390 条 AI2-THOR Observation-Thought-Action 轨迹，串联 GPT-4o 模仿数据、环境过滤自探索与失败感知反思调优。
why: It provides an auditable example of turning simulator state checks and failed prefixes into multimodal process supervision, while showing why candidate attrition, alternative valid paths, trace faithfulness, replay, and release loadability must be checked separately from benchmark gains.
inclusion_reason: Embodied-Reasoner connects simulator task synthesis, GPT-4o thought writing, environment-filtered policy exploration, failed-prefix correction, and an open multimodal state-action release across a single three-stage recipe.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Embodied reasoning data must connect a task to egocentric observations, intermediate decisions, executable actions, environment transitions, and a terminal outcome. A terminal success flag alone cannot show whether the thoughts were visually grounded, whether an exploratory detour was necessary, or whether a correction label identifies the first causal error.

Embodied-Reasoner studies this construction problem in AI2-THOR. It combines GPT-4o-assisted imitation traces, policy-generated exploration accepted by simulator checks, and reflection/correction examples made from anomalous states or failed prefixes. Because the authors release the trajectory corpus and construction code, the relevant object is not just a trained model: it is an auditable chain from simulator metadata and task templates to image-text-action records, verifier decisions, and downstream SFT objectives.

具身推理数据需要把任务、自我中心观察、中间决策、可执行动作、环境转移和终止结果连成完整链路。单一的终态成功标记无法说明思考是否真正扎根于视觉，也无法判断探索绕路是否必要，或纠正标签是否找到了第一个因果错误。

Embodied-Reasoner 在 AI2-THOR 中研究这一构造问题。其流水线结合 GPT-4o 辅助的模仿轨迹、经模拟器检查后保留的策略自探索，以及由异常状态或失败前缀生成的反思/纠正样本。由于作者公开了轨迹语料与构造代码，审计对象不只是训练后的模型，而是从模拟器元数据和任务模板，到图文动作记录、验证器判定及下游 SFT 目标的完整链路。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The released training object contains 9,390 trajectories: 1,128 Stage-1 synthetic imitation episodes with 4,636 images, 6,246 Stage-2 accepted self-exploration episodes with about 45.8K images, and 2,016 Stage-3 reflection/correction episodes with about 13.8K images. The paper separately reports about 64K images, 8M thought tokens, and roughly 90K occurrences of five thought patterns—situation analysis, task planning, spatial reasoning, self-reflection, and double verification. The 90K figure is not a count of independent examples.

Each example is a multi-turn Observation-Thought-Action episode. User turns provide an egocentric image and interaction feedback; assistant turns provide reasoning and a discrete high-level action. The origin-format records also expose task family/subtask, scene, instruction template and variants, ordered key actions, object identifiers and types, per-action rewards, total reward, trajectory strings, and image paths. The dialogue file converts the same 9,390 trajectories into training messages, so these are two representations of the corpus rather than two additive sets.

The environment is AI2-THOR: training spans 107 scenes, about 2,100 objects, and about 2,600 containers. The action vocabulary includes observation, motion/navigation, pickup, placement, opening/closing, toggling, and termination. This state-action context makes the records richer than free-form chain-of-thought transcripts, while missing seeds and build hashes still prevent guaranteed deterministic replay.

发布的训练对象包含 9,390 条轨迹：第一阶段为 1,128 条合成模仿 episode、4,636 张图像；第二阶段为 6,246 条通过筛选的自探索 episode、约 45.8K 张图像；第三阶段为 2,016 条反思/纠正 episode、约 13.8K 张图像。论文还分别报告约 64K 张图像、8M 个 thought token，以及约 90K 次五类思考模式出现：situation analysis、task planning、spatial reasoning、self-reflection 和 double verification。约 90K 不是独立样本数。

每条样本都是多轮 Observation-Thought-Action episode。user 轮提供自我中心图像与交互反馈，assistant 轮输出推理和一个离散高层动作。原始格式还包含任务类/子任务、场景、指令模板及变体、有序关键动作、对象 ID 与类型、逐动作奖励、总奖励、轨迹字符串和图像路径。dialogue 文件只是把同一批 9,390 条轨迹转换成训练消息，因此两种格式不能相加计数。

环境为 AI2-THOR：训练覆盖 107 个场景、约 2,100 个对象和约 2,600 个容器；动作集合包含观察、移动/导航、拾取、放置、开关容器、切换设备和终止。这样的状态—动作上下文比自由文本思维链更丰富，但缺少随机种子和不可变 build hash，仍不足以保证确定性回放。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reconstructable pipeline has three data stages:

  1. Build tasks and teacher traces. Start from search, manipulate, transport, and composite task families covering ten training subtasks. Use simulator metadata and GPT-4o-generated constraint checks to choose valid object/container combinations, then rewrite instantiated templates as varied instructions and combine simple tasks when needed. An object-affiliation graph yields a minimum ordered key-action sequence; extra search actions can be inserted. Execute the actions in AI2-THOR to capture observations. GPT-4o receives the preceding interaction plus the already selected next action and writes one or more of five thought types. Fine-tune Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct on 1,128 resulting trajectories to obtain Embodied-Interactor.
  2. Collect environment-filtered exploration. On new tasks, Embodied-Interactor samples multiple high-temperature trajectories across iterative rounds. The data engine functions as a process/terminal verifier: every key action must appear in order and the final simulator state must satisfy the task. Extra exploratory actions do not automatically fail an episode. The 6,246 accepted episodes train Embodied-Explorer; total candidates, rejects, pass rate, temperature, top-p, retry budget, and seeds are unknown.
  3. Create reflection/correction supervision. Embodied-Explorer rolls out earlier tasks. For successful episodes, the engine injects navigation or manipulation anomalies and adds reflective reasoning before retry. For failures, it compares the rollout with synthesized key actions, locates the first incorrect action, appends self-reflection and a corrective continuation, and masks the erroneous partial trajectory. Stage-3 loss applies only to reflection and corrected tokens. The two sources yield 2,016 trajectories, but their mixture, selection criteria, anomaly distribution, and first-error accuracy are unknown.

All stages use multi-turn image-text dialogue with learning loss on assistant reasoning/action tokens. The repository exposes the task engine, dataset format, a custom LLaMA-Factory dependency, and generic train/evaluation scripts. It does not expose a paper-matching stage-by-stage manifest with exact optimizer, hardware, batch schedule, learning rate, epochs, checkpoint mapping, or random seeds.

可重建的流水线包含三个数据阶段：

  1. 构造任务与教师轨迹。 从 search、manipulate、transport 和 composite 四类任务出发，覆盖十个训练子任务。利用模拟器元数据和 GPT-4o 生成的约束检查选择有效对象/容器组合，再把实例化模板改写为多样指令，并按需组合简单任务。对象隶属图给出最小有序关键动作序列，也可插入额外搜索动作。随后在 AI2-THOR 中执行动作并捕获观察。GPT-4o 接收此前交互以及已经选定的下一动作，生成五类思考中的一种或多种。用得到的 1,128 条轨迹微调 Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct，形成 Embodied-Interactor。
  2. 收集经环境筛选的探索。 Embodied-Interactor 在新任务上跨多轮进行多次高温采样。数据引擎充当过程/终态验证器：所有关键动作必须按序出现，且最终模拟器状态满足任务；额外探索动作不会自动导致失败。最终保留的 6,246 条 episode 用于训练 Embodied-Explorer。候选总数、拒绝数、通过率、temperature、top-p、重试预算和随机种子均为 unknown。
  3. 生成反思/纠正监督。 Embodied-Explorer 对先前任务再次 rollout。对于成功 episode，引擎注入导航或操作异常，并在重试前加入反思思考；对于失败 episode，则与合成关键动作比较，定位首个错误动作，追加 self-reflection 和纠正后续，并屏蔽错误的部分轨迹。第三阶段只在反思与纠正 token 上计算损失。两种来源共得到 2,016 条轨迹，但其混合比例、选择标准、异常分布和首错定位准确率均为 unknown。

三个阶段都采用多轮图文对话，并只在 assistant 的推理/动作 token 上计算学习损失。仓库公开了任务引擎、数据格式、定制 LLaMA-Factory 依赖和通用训练/评测脚本，但没有给出与论文逐阶段匹配的优化器、硬件、batch 调度、学习率、epoch、检查点映射和随机种子清单。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The formal ACL paper and appendix document the three stages, data counts, verifier contract, 809-case simulator evaluation, 25 ultra-long tasks, and 30-task human-mediated real-world evaluation. The official project page verifies the formal 14-author/9-affiliation record and reports the main results. The official repository exposes task-generation and trajectory-generation code plus generic training/evaluation entry points. The official dataset lists the 9,390 origin records, the matching dialogue conversion, images, 809-case test data, Apache-2.0 declaration, and a total size of 157 GB.

On the 809 simulator cases, the paper reports overall Success Rate / Search Efficiency / Task Completeness of 14.79 / 11.97 / 38.67 for the Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct base, 25.46 / 24.75 / 53.67 after Stage 1, 65.39 / 46.25 / 77.73 after Stage 2, and 80.96 / 55.07 / 86.30 after Stage 3. This ordered ablation is consistent with benefits from each training stage under the paper's setup. The final model's composite-task success is 54.29%, compared with 14.42% for GPT-4o, while its search-task success is 65.16%, below GPT-o3-mini's 78.57%; the authors attribute search weakness to over-exploration and missed nearby objects.

The reported real-world test contains 30 tasks across kitchen, bathroom, and bedroom scenes, with a human holding the camera and executing model commands. Embodied-Reasoner reaches 56.7% success versus 50.0% for GPT-o1, 44.0% for GPT-o3-mini, and 43.3% for Qwen2.5-VL-72B. These are small, human-mediated author results without uncertainty. Neither simulator nor real-world benchmark performance independently validates every synthetic thought, establishes a unique correct action path, or proves record-level release quality.

ACL 正式论文及附录记录了三阶段流程、数据量、验证契约、809 条模拟器评测、25 条超长任务，以及 30 条由人类代执行的真实环境评测。官方项目页核实了正式版本的 14 位作者和 9 个机构，并列出主要结果。官方仓库公开任务生成、轨迹生成代码及通用训练/评测入口。官方数据集列出 9,390 条原始记录、对应的 dialogue 转换、图像、809 条测试数据、Apache-2.0 声明及 157 GB 总体积。

在 809 条模拟器样例上，论文报告 Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct 基座的 Success Rate / Search Efficiency / Task Completeness 为 14.79 / 11.97 / 38.67；第一阶段后为 25.46 / 24.75 / 53.67；第二阶段后为 65.39 / 46.25 / 77.73；第三阶段后为 80.96 / 55.07 / 86.30。这组顺序消融与各训练阶段在论文设置下均有贡献相一致。最终模型的 composite 任务成功率为 54.29%，GPT-4o 为 14.42%；但其 search 成功率为 65.16%，低于 GPT-o3-mini 的 78.57%，作者将该弱项归因于过度探索和忽略近处对象。

真实环境评测包含厨房、浴室和卧室中的 30 个任务，由人类持相机并执行模型命令。Embodied-Reasoner 成功率为 56.7%，GPT-o1、GPT-o3-mini 和 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 分别为 50.0%、44.0% 和 43.3%。这是样本较小、由人代执行且未报告不确定性的作者结果。无论模拟器还是现实评测，都不能独立验证每条合成思考、证明动作路径唯一正确，或证明发布数据逐条高质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Embodied imitation data, simulator-generated tasks, rejection sampling, and reflection tuning each have precedents. The distinctive data contribution is their record-level linkage across three stages: simulator metadata creates constrained tasks and ordered key actions; GPT-4o supplies image-interleaved thought supervision; the current policy explores; an environmental checker retains successful episodes; and selected successes or failures become masked reflection/correction examples.

The recipe also separates two feedback roles that are often conflated. Stage 2 supplies an environmental acceptance contract over an entire rollout, while Stage 3 turns a synthesized first-error location into token-level supervision on a corrected suffix. Successes and failures therefore enter different downstream training sets instead of being reduced to one scalar score.

This linkage is useful but does not establish trace faithfulness. GPT-4o writes a thought while seeing the upcoming selected action, so the text can rationalize that action after the fact. Environmental success verifies task completion, not whether the written reasoning caused the action. The paper is therefore most novel as an open construction recipe connecting trace writing, verifier-based selection, and correction masking—not as proof that its chain-of-thought is causally faithful.

具身模仿数据、模拟器任务生成、拒绝采样和反思调优各自都有先例。该工作的独特数据贡献，是在三个阶段中建立记录级连接：模拟器元数据生成受约束任务与有序关键动作；GPT-4o 提供与图像交错的思考监督；当前策略执行探索；环境检查器保留成功 episode；选定的成功或失败记录再转成带 mask 的反思/纠正样本。

该配方还区分了两类常被混在一起的反馈。第二阶段提供作用于完整 rollout 的环境接受契约；第三阶段则把合成的首错位置转为纠正后缀上的 token 级监督。因此，成功与失败会进入不同的下游训练集，而不是被压缩为单一标量分数。

这种链路并不等于轨迹忠实性。GPT-4o 在看到已经选定的下一动作后生成思考，因此文本可能只是事后解释。环境成功能验证任务完成，却不能证明书面推理导致了动作。其主要新意更适合概括为：把轨迹写作、基于验证器的筛选和纠正 mask 连接成开放数据配方，而非证明思维链具有因果忠实性。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Verifier scope is narrower than reasoning quality. Ordered key-action coverage plus a correct final state does not test whether thoughts are grounded, intermediate actions are rational, or the trajectory is minimal. Because non-key exploration is allowed, a successful but inefficient episode can pass. Because the key path is synthesized, another valid action ordering can also be rejected or mislabeled during first-error localization.
  • Candidate accounting is missing. The paper reports 6,246 accepted Stage-2 episodes but not total rollouts, rejected counts, per-task pass rates, failure categories, retry policy, or the complete failed pool. Stage-3 source proportions, anomaly sampling, and first-error-label accuracy are also unknown.
  • Generation and training settings are incomplete. The GPT-4o snapshot/prompts, Stage-2 temperature and top-p, rollout budget, maximum steps/tokens, seeds, stage-specific optimizer settings, hardware, batch schedule, epochs, and paper-checkpoint mapping are unknown. Generic repository launchers are not a paper-matching manifest.
  • Replay is partial. The release includes scene/object IDs, image paths, actions, key actions, and an AI2-THOR dependency version, but not immutable Unity/build hashes, initial-state and randomization seeds, or complete action/transition logs. Exact episode replay and re-verification are therefore not guaranteed.
  • The current release needs a loader audit. The Hugging Face page reports 157 GB, but the Dataset Viewer fails at revision e498d661e45b1ccf5694e4e8bfd825eee58e0051: test_809.json has a 15-field evaluation schema while dialogue records use id, messages, and images. Separate configurations or a tested loader are not provided on the page.
  • Evaluation does not certify the corpus. The 809 simulator cases are author-curated and scene-disjoint by report, but template, instruction, object-combination, and teacher-output overlap are not audited. Search Efficiency is key-action count divided by predicted-action count, while Task Completeness measures the proportion of predicted actions that are key actions; neither metric proves that every record is correct or that all necessary exploration is represented fairly.
  • Rights and release scope remain incomplete. Code is MulanPSL-2.0 and the dataset card declares Apache-2.0, but no asset-level provenance/NOTICE mapping is published for the simulator renders. GPT-4o output terms, Qwen2-VL derivative obligations, and any model-weight license require separate checks; an official author-owned model-weight repository was not verified. The release also lacks an explicit privacy statement distinguishing simulator images from the human-mediated real-world evaluation media.

• 验证器覆盖范围小于推理质量。 关键动作按序出现且终态正确，并不能检查思考是否扎根、中间动作是否合理或轨迹是否最短。由于允许非关键探索，成功但低效的 episode 也可通过；由于关键路径本身是合成的，另一条有效动作顺序也可能在首错定位时被拒绝或误标。
  • 缺少候选核算。 论文报告第二阶段保留 6,246 条 episode，却未披露总 rollout 数、拒绝数、逐任务通过率、失败类别、重试策略和完整失败池。第三阶段两种来源的比例、异常采样方式和首错标签准确率也为 unknown。
  • 生成与训练设置不完整。 GPT-4o 快照/提示、第二阶段 temperature 与 top-p、rollout 预算、最大步数/token、随机种子、逐阶段优化器设置、硬件、batch 调度、epoch 和论文检查点映射均为 unknown。仓库中的通用启动脚本不能替代与论文匹配的清单。
  • 回放能力不完整。 发布包含场景/对象 ID、图像路径、动作、关键动作和 AI2-THOR 依赖版本，但缺少不可变 Unity/build hash、初始状态与随机化种子，以及完整动作/状态转移日志，因此不能保证精确回放与复验。
  • 当前发布需要加载器审计。 Hugging Face 页面报告总体积 157 GB，但 revision e498d661e45b1ccf5694e4e8bfd825eee58e0051 的 Dataset Viewer 失败：test_809.json 使用 15 字段评测 schema，而 dialogue 记录使用 id、messages 和 images。页面没有提供分离 configuration 或经测试的加载器。
  • 评测不能替数据背书。 809 条模拟器样例由作者人工整理，并声称与训练场景分离，但未审计模板、指令、对象组合和教师输出重叠。Search Efficiency 是关键动作数除以预测动作数，Task Completeness 是预测动作中属于关键动作的比例；二者都不能证明每条记录正确，也不能证明必要探索得到公平表示。
  • 权利与发布范围仍不完整。 代码采用 MulanPSL-2.0，数据集卡声明 Apache-2.0，但未公开模拟器渲染资产的逐项溯源/NOTICE 映射。GPT-4o 输出条款、Qwen2-VL 衍生义务及任何模型权重许可证仍需单独核查；本卡未验证到作者自有的官方模型权重仓库。发布还缺少明确的隐私说明，以区分模拟器图像与由人代执行的真实环境评测媒体。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within the assigned data_construction_open_release_recipes track, Embodied-Reasoner is a concrete reference for constructing multimodal agent data with three linked feedback layers: a teacher writes step reasoning, an environment checker selects complete rollouts, and a failure-analysis stage converts an erroneous prefix into masked correction supervision. Its origin format also demonstrates why an open trajectory release should retain task and scene identifiers, prompt/template lineage, ordered observations, explicit actions and object arguments, key-action references, per-step rewards, and terminal state alongside an SFT-ready dialogue view.

A stronger reuse would preserve additional audit objects that this release omits: every candidate rollout and verifier decision, rejection reason, alternative-valid-plan handling, anomaly provenance, first-error confidence, simulator/build pin, initial-state seed, action-transition log, deterministic replay test, stage-specific training config, and immutable file/checkpoint hashes. Train and evaluation data should also be packaged as separate loadable configurations with documented schemas.

The recipe is most directly reusable for embodied visual search, household manipulation, multimodal agent SFT/distillation, process supervision, and verifier-aware data engineering. Its reported stage gains justify studying the pipeline, but benchmark performance should remain downstream evidence rather than a substitute for item-level validation, replay, decontamination, or rights review.

在指定的 data_construction_open_release_recipes 轨道中，Embodied-Reasoner 是一个具体的多模态智能体数据构造参考，串联三层反馈：教师编写逐步推理，环境检查器筛选完整 rollout，失败分析阶段再把错误前缀转为带 mask 的纠正监督。其原始格式也说明，开放轨迹发布应在 SFT-ready dialogue 之外保留任务与场景 ID、prompt/模板 lineage、有序观察、显式动作及对象参数、关键动作参考、逐步奖励和终态。

更稳健的复用应补齐当前发布缺失的审计对象：所有候选 rollout 及验证器判定、拒绝原因、替代有效方案处理、异常来源、首错置信度、模拟器/build 固定信息、初始状态种子、动作—状态转移日志、确定性回放测试、逐阶段训练配置，以及不可变文件/检查点 hash。训练与评测数据还应拆成可独立加载的 configuration，并记录清晰 schema。

该配方最适合用于具身视觉搜索、家居操作、多模态智能体 SFT/蒸馏、过程监督和验证器感知的数据工程。论文报告的阶段增益支持研究这条流水线，但基准表现应被视为下游证据，不能替代逐条验证、回放、去污染和权利审查。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read the data engine and three-stage training sections together. The key lineage is 1,128 teacher traces -> 6,246 environment-accepted policy rollouts -> 2,016 anomaly/failure correction records -> 9,390 released trajectories.
  • Keep the scale units separate: 9,390 trajectories, about 64K images, 8M thought tokens, and about 90K thought-pattern occurrences.
  • Treat ordered key-action coverage plus the correct final state as the Stage-2 acceptance contract. Search Efficiency, Task Completeness, and repeated-exploration rate are evaluation metrics, not extra acceptance rules.
  • Inspect how the thought was produced: GPT-4o sees the upcoming selected action. This is a direct trace-faithfulness risk even when the episode succeeds environmentally.
  • Read the task breakdown, not only the aggregate 80.96% success rate. The final 7B model reports 65.16% on search and 54.29% on composite tasks; the former trails GPT-o3-mini in the paper's table.
  • Before reuse, pin the paper, code, and data revisions; repair or bypass the current mixed-schema HF viewer failure; verify episode counts and file hashes; and test replay, alternative valid plans, failure labels, rights, and model availability independently.

• 将数据引擎与三阶段训练章节连起来读。关键 lineage 是：1,128 条教师轨迹 -> 6,246 条经环境筛选的策略 rollout -> 2,016 条异常/失败纠正记录 -> 9,390 条发布轨迹。
  • 严格区分计量单位：9,390 条轨迹、约 64K 张图像、8M 个 thought token，以及约 90K 次思考模式出现。
  • 把“关键动作按序覆盖 + 正确终态”视为第二阶段接受契约。Search Efficiency、Task Completeness 和重复探索率是评测指标，不是附加接受规则。
  • 注意思考的生成条件：GPT-4o 能看到已经选定的下一动作。即使 episode 在环境中成功，这仍是直接的轨迹忠实性风险。
  • 不要只看总体 80.96% 成功率，应同时查看任务分解。最终 7B 模型在 search 和 composite 上分别为 65.16% 与 54.29%；其中 search 在论文表格中低于 GPT-o3-mini。
  • 复用前应固定论文、代码和数据 revision，修复或绕过当前 HF 混合 schema 的 viewer 故障，核验 episode 数与文件 hash，并分别测试回放、替代有效方案、失败标签、权利和模型可用性。
